the parents of obese children reported lack of access to facilities for physical activity, lack of access of appropriate place for physical activity, and lack of enough information on how to improve physical activity as barriers to physical activity, and media advertisement of unhealthy food, lack of motivation, and lack of information about healthy eating as barriers to healthy eating, and lack of knowledge about benefits of sleep, late sleep time, and watching television as barriers to sleep.

the barriers to healthy lifestyles among adolescents from the parental perspective are lack of access to affordable and appropriate facilities for PA, and insufficient information and motivation about healthy eating and sleep.
the main barriers to healthy lifestyle among obese children were lack of access to affordable PA facilities, lack of access and motivation to do PA, and lack information about healthy eating and PA.

providing the necessary information to improve healthy lifestyle in adolescents.
the barriers to healthy eating, PA, and sleep from the parental perspective.
the importance of the role of parents and community in promoting healthy lifestyles in children and adolescents.

parents of obese and/or overweight children and adolescents are aware of their children's barriers to healthy lifestyles and they can play an essential role in improving their lifestyle behaviors.

the parents of obese adolescents should be trained to promote a healthy lifestyle.

, the main barriers to healthy lifestyle behaviors among children and adolescents were lack of access to facilities for PA, and insufficient knowledge of parents regarding PA and healthy nutrition.
